opus.role: independent design judge, no maker context (delegation_policy.md §4)

brief: delegation_policy.md §4.3 design call: item criteria + governing design doc + touched standing rulings
subject: c7f5b6a928

reasons: ship_shields_deep_design.md RULED table, thermal-veil row (owner verbatim): "Just use power for fuel ... Power does the trick. All shields are modulated plasma fields" - power is the shields' fuel; no fuel, no field.

loadout-tradeoff row (owner verbatim): "they should be the same shields, you're just installing modules" - applying the power rule to the bubble as to the other three fields is applying his ruling to a case it does not name (delegated, policy §2.4), not changing it.

bubble-not-wall row (owner verbatim): "prone to overheating or even explosion when forcibly collapsed" - a power cut is a shutdown, not a forcible collapse; keeping the explosion on HP-break only is the narrower reading and avoids a blackout or solar flare detonating every generator at once (consistent with no-hard-landing-gate: "no environment is immediately lethal").
HP kept, no recharge while unpowered (HitPointsPerInterval returns 0 unpowered), returns at prior HP - no free healing, no punishment; simplest coherent reading.
No conflict found in standing_rulings.md, biome_rulings.md or CLAUDE.md (only shield hit: standing_rulings.md:160, shade items, unrelated).

Mechanic follows the arc: §3 pass is "revocable" and REVOKE is the arc's own verb; reverting one striker to the baseline every non-holder already has (mechanoid faction hostile, faction-level hostility untouched) is withdrawal of tolerance, not vengeance (law block + §6.2: "no manhunts, no pursuit, no Sentinel vengeance story"; §8: "no raid, no manhunt"). No goodwill, raid or clan-wide revoke keeps clan-level cooling with the GM layer, as §3/§6 place it.

Exclusions (stray shots via IntendedTarget, Extinguish, mental states) keep it to the player's deliberate choice; a simpler 'temporary hostility while attacking' reading would need a new timer mechanism the spec never names and leaves the holder able to resume immunity - the permanent per-pawn revoke is the simpler reading.

REVISE: the player-facing message "The Cathedral's machines no longer know <pawn>." attributes cognition (recognition) to the machines and implicitly explains their prior mercy. Arc law block: before the reveal every beat "must read, in-world, as a place with strange weather - never as a person"; Cathedral sheet ban 2: "no explanation of the droids' mercy"; §3: letters are "the world describing behavior, never intent"; §8 grep gate: no player-facing string attributes agency before stage 3. Pass grant happens at VOUCHED, before the reveal, so this string can fire pre-reveal.
Exact fix: replace the string with behaviour-register text matching the RUT_CathedralPass hediff description, e.g. "The old sentinels no longer look away from <pawn>." No code logic change.
